p: Wine is a mocker: By wine here is meant him that is given to wine, and so by strong drink.
sinneth against his own soul: Puts his life in danger.
man is like deep water: It is hard to find out: for it is as deep waters, whose bottom cannot be found: yet the wise man will know a man either by his words or manners.
scattereth away all evil with his: Where righteous judgment is executed, there sin ceases, and vice dare not appear.
them are alike abomination to the: Read Pr 16:11.
garment that is surety for a: Teach him wit, that he cast not himself rashly into danger.
devoureth that which is holy: That is, to apply or take for his own use, that which was appointed to God's and then ask how he may be exempted from the fault.
wheel over them: Which was a kind of punishment then used.
spirit of man is the lamp: The word of God gives life to man and causes us to see and try the secret of our dark hearts, He 4:12.
The blueness of a wound cleanseth: Sharp punishment that pierces even the inward parts is profitable for the wicked to bring them to amendment.
